rationale.complete: Round 1 is done: synthetic validation, 9 per-period verdicts, scorecard, and a confirmatory script written and dry-run. The holdout, the Jev-state rerun, the remaining regime-I periods and an NE14 event study are open.
rationale.faithfulness: The hypothesis as posed failed. There is no per-family arrow (HH19), no collective term (HH67), the predicted work cycles did not appear, and the coarse arrow is carried by the scaffold (rival R1). Single-agent arrows do beat a calibrated detailed-balance null (strongly on fine classes, in long windows, and in regime I), so the result beats some nulls (C = 1) but supports the rivals.
rationale.usefulness: A computable diagnostic (per-agent irreversibility vs. a detailed-balance surrogate) with a weakly stable agent fingerprint and a methods warning about shuffle nulls. But most of what it measures is the harness (tool micro-order, consolidation cadence), so there is no steering handle.

one_line: Irreversibility lives in fine tool actions and scaffold steps; no per-family (HH19) or collective (HH67) arrow
